1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Package original review instructions for complete, bounded Read calls.
3	
4	This helper never opens subject files or evaluates profile predicates. It checks
5	instruction membership/completeness and prints paths to read, not a review gate.
6	"""
7	import argparse
8	import hashlib
9	import json
10	from pathlib import Path
11	import re
12	import tempfile
13	
14	ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
15	COMMON = (
16	    "skills/review-code/packet-preparation.md",
17	    "skills/review-code/review-process.md",
18	    "skills/review-code/shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md",
19	    "skills/review-code/shared-profile-detection.md",
20	    "skills/review-code/shared-review-scope-protocol.md",
21	    "skills/review-code/shared-change-context.md",
22	    "skills/review-code/functional-review.md",
23	)
24	PART_BYTES = 12000
25	
26	
27	def read_instruction(root, relative):
28	    path = root / relative
29	    resolved = path.resolve()
30	    if (Path(relative).is_absolute() or ".." in Path(relative).parts
31	            or any(part in {"evals", "oracle"} for part in Path(relative).parts)
32	            or not resolved.is_relative_to(root.resolve())
33	            or any(part in {"evals", "oracle"} for part in resolved.relative_to(root.resolve()).parts)):
34	        raise ValueError("Instruction path escapes the plugin boundary: " + relative)
35	    return path.read_bytes()
36	
37	
38	def known_profiles(root):
39	    text = read_instruction(root, "skills/review-code/shared-profile-detection.md").decode()
40	    match = re.search(r"^### Known profiles\s*\n(.*?)(?=^### |\Z)", text, re.M | re.S)
41	    profiles = re.findall(r"^- `([a-z0-9_-]+)`\s*$", match[1], re.M) if match else []
42	    if not profiles or len(profiles) != len(set(profiles)):
43	        raise ValueError("Cannot resolve the authoritative Known profiles list")
44	    return profiles
45	
46	
47	def checklist_entries(root, profile):
48	    text = read_instruction(root, f"profiles/{profile}/review-code/index.md").decode()
49	    sections = re.split(r"^## (Always load|Conditional)\s*$", text, flags=re.M)
50	    entries = {}
51	    for i in range(1, len(sections), 2):
52	        for name in re.findall(r"\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+\.md)\)", sections[i + 1]):
53	            if Path(name).name != name or name in entries:
54	                raise ValueError("Unsupported or duplicate index path: " + name)
55	            entries[name] = sections[i] == "Always load"
56	    if not entries:
57	        raise ValueError("Empty or unsupported review index: " + profile)
58	    return entries
59	
60	
61	def select_sources(root, phase, profiles=(), selected=(), skipped=()):
62	    known = known_profiles(root)
63	    if len(profiles) != len(set(profiles)) or any(p not in known for p in profiles):
64	        raise ValueError("Profiles must be distinct members of Known profiles")
65	    unavailable = []
66	    sources = []
67	    if phase == "bootstrap":
68	        sources.extend((p, read_instruction(root, p)) for p in COMMON)
69	        for profile in known:
70	            relative = f"profiles/{profile}/DETECTION.md"
71	            try:
72	                sources.append((relative, read_instruction(root, relative)))
73	            except FileNotFoundError:
74	                unavailable.append({"path": relative, "outcome": "ENOENT"})
75	    elif phase == "profiles":
76	        for profile in profiles:
77	            relative = f"profiles/{profile}/review-code/index.md"
78	            sources.append((relative, read_instruction(root, relative)))
79	    elif phase == "checklists":
80	        decisions = {}
81	        for path in selected:
82	            if path in decisions:
83	                raise ValueError("Duplicate checklist decision: " + path)
84	            decisions[path] = (True, "selected by actor routing")
85	        for entry in skipped:
86	            path, separator, reason = entry.partition("=")
87	            if not separator or not reason.strip() or path in decisions:
88	                raise ValueError("Skipped checklist needs one explicit reason: " + entry)
89	            decisions[path] = (False, reason)
90	        expected = {}
91	        for profile in profiles:
92	            expected.update({f"{profile}/{name}": required
93	                             for name, required in checklist_entries(root, profile).items()})
94	        if set(decisions) != set(expected):
95	            raise ValueError("Every active-profile index entry needs a load/skip decision")
96	        for path, required in expected.items():
97	            load, reason = decisions[path]
98	            if required and not load:
99	                raise ValueError("Cannot skip an always-load checklist: " + path)
100	            if load:
101	                profile, name = path.split("/")
102	                relative = f"profiles/{profile}/review-code/{name}"
103	                sources.append((relative, read_instruction(root, relative)))
104	            else:
105	                unavailable.append({"path": path, "outcome": "conditional not selected", "reason": reason})
106	    else:
107	        raise ValueError("Unknown packet phase")
108	    return sources, unavailable
109	
110	
111	def write_packet(root, phase, sources, unavailable):
112	    """Preserve source bytes; frame and split them without truncating content."""
113	    pieces, current, inventory = [], b"", []
114	    for relative, content in sources:
115	        digest = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
116	        inventory.append({"source": str(root / relative), "sha256": digest,
117	                          "bytes": len(content)})
118	        framed = (f"\nBEGIN SOURCE {root / relative}\nSHA256 {digest}\n"
119	                  "Resolve links relative to this original source path.\n\n").encode() + content + b"\nEND SOURCE\n"
120	        for line in framed.splitlines(keepends=True):
121	            if len(line) > PART_BYTES:
122	                raise ValueError("Instruction line exceeds packet bound; use direct Read")
123	            if len(current) + len(line) > PART_BYTES:
124	                pieces.append(current)
125	                current = b""
126	            current += line
127	    if current:
128	        pieces.append(current)
129	    # No caller-controlled destination, overwrite or subject-tree write.
130	    destination = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="kk-review-instructions-"))
131	    manifest = {"phase": phase, "plugin_root": str(root), "sources": inventory,
132	                "routing_outcomes": unavailable, "parts": [],
133	                "gate": "NOT ESTABLISHED: read every complete part before investigation"}
134	    for number, content in enumerate(pieces, 1):
135	        path = destination / f"part-{number:02d}.md"
136	        header = f"Instruction packet {phase}: part {number}/{len(pieces)}\n\n".encode()
137	        footer = f"\nEND PACKET PART {number}/{len(pieces)}\n".encode()
138	        path.write_bytes(header + content + footer)
139	        path.chmod(0o400)
140	        manifest["parts"].append({"path": str(path), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
141	    manifest_path = destination / "manifest.json"
142	    manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n")
143	    manifest_path.chmod(0o400)
144	    return manifest
145	
146	
147	def main():
148	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
149	    parser.add_argument("phase", choices=("bootstrap", "profiles", "checklists"))
150	    parser.add_argument("--profile", action="append", default=[])
151	    parser.add_argument("--load", action="append", default=[])
152	    parser.add_argument("--skip", action="append", default=[])
153	    args = parser.parse_args()
154	    if args.phase != "checklists" and (args.load or args.skip):
155	        parser.error("--load/--skip belong to the checklists phase")
156	    sources, unavailable = select_sources(ROOT, args.phase, args.profile, args.load, args.skip)
157	    print(json.dumps(write_packet(ROOT, args.phase, sources, unavailable), indent=2))
158	
159	
160	if __name__ == "__main__":
161	    main()
